# Codex Cortex Upstream Snapshot

Selective third-party custody for the MARK-172, MARK-200, MARK-201, MARK-204,
MARK-205, and MARK-210 Claude-Cortex seeds.

This snapshot keeps only the material needed for the
`cqrs-event-sourcing`, `event-driven-architecture`, `database-design-patterns`,
`api-design-patterns`, `openapi-specification`, and
`threat-modeling-techniques` imports plus their local reference docs. It is
intentionally narrow and does not retain later Claude-Cortex candidates beyond
MARK-210.
